caption: Watch photographer and still life photographer in New York

analysis.composition: Centered hero product shot with a slight three-quarter angle to showcase dial depth and case profile.
analysis.negative_space: Extensive dark vignette surrounding the subject, focusing attention entirely on the timepiece.
analysis.lighting: Professional studio lighting with sharp specular highlights on the polished bezel and lugs, emphasizing the metallic texture and guilloché dial pattern.
analysis.typography: Brand logo and name printed on the dial; no external campaign typography.
analysis.reason: High-end commercial product photography of a Jacob & Co watch. The image clearly displays the dial, hands, fluted bezel, and strap texture with excellent lighting control. It fits the watches category perfectly.
